suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-19 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. The cited KDIGO clinical practice guideline addresses diabetes management in chronic kidney disease and recognizes diabetic kidney disease as a leading cause of chronic kidney disease. Require established diabetic nephropathy (documented albuminuria and/or persistent eGFR decline in a person with diabetes with a compatible phenotype) and separately documented chronic kidney disease; the cited KDIGO clinical practice guideline addresses diabetes management in chronic kidney disease and recognizes diabetic kidney disease as a leading cause of chronic kidney disease, without establishing that any individual's chronic kidney disease is diabetic in origin. Preserve hypertensive, ischemic/renovascular, obstructive, primary glomerular, interstitial, and other chronic kidney disease etiologies as competing explanations. Do not infer diabetic nephropathy from isolated creatinine elevation or from diabetes alone, and do not treat this guideline-framed association as proof that diabetic nephropathy caused an individual's chronic kidney disease. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
